mapper.select: SELECT * FROM paper ORDER BY featured DESC, year DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM paper WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper (title, authors, venue, year, status, abstract_text, tags, pdf_url, code_url, project_url, dataset_url, featured) VALUES (#{title}, #{authors}, #{venue}, #{year}, #{status}, #{abstractText}, #{tags}, #{pdfUrl}, #{codeUrl}, #{projectUrl}, #{datasetUrl}, #{featured})
mapper.update: UPDATE paper SET title=#{title}, authors=#{authors}, venue=#{venue}, year=#{year}, status=#{status}, abstract_text=#{abstractText}, tags=#{tags}, pdf_url=#{pdfUrl}, code_url=#{codeUrl}, project_url=#{projectUrl}, dataset_url=#{datasetUrl}, featured=#{featured} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE paper SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
